title: Adopted etale relative product with finite stalk coefficients
statement: Let $A$ be a concrete Grothendieck abelian category [def-sp-grothendieck-abelian] with a closed symmetric monoidal, additive tensor structure and functorial flat resolutions. Here an object is finitely generated when a finite set of its underlying elements is contained in no proper subobject: every monomorphism into it whose underlying range contains that set is an isomorphism. Assume small-site sheafification for $A$. For a scheme $T$ [def-pc-scheme], write $D(T,A)=D(\operatorname{Sh}(T_{\mathrm{et}},A))$ for its ordinary unbounded derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. The tensor $\otimes^L$ is the K-flat derived tensor [def-kun-derived-tensor], with $A$ as its coefficient category. Say that $C\in D(T,A)$ is constructible finite-Tor if it has only finitely many nonzero cohomology sheaves, each is locally constant with finitely generated geometric stalks on a finite locally closed constructible partition, and $C\otimes^L F[0]$ has cohomology in one fixed finite interval for every $A$-valued sheaf $F$. Say its cohomology stalks are torsion if, for each integer $i$ and geometric point $t$, there is an integer $r>0$ with $r\operatorname{id}_{H^i(C)_t}=0$. For a compactifiable morphism $h$, choose a factorization $h=pj$ with $j$ open and $p$ proper, and set $Rh_!=Rp_*j_!$ using that chosen factorization [def-weil-compactifications-refinements]. Assume every finitely generated object of $A$ has finite underlying type. Let $f:X\to B$ and $g:Y\to B$ be quasi-compact compactifiable morphisms and assume the structure map $h:X\times_B Y\to B$ compactifiable. Let $K\in D(X,A)$ and $M\in D(Y,A)$ be constructible finite-Tor. With fibre-product projections $p,q$, there exists an object isomorphism $Rh_!(Lp^*K\otimes^L Lq^*M)\cong Rf_!K\otimes^L Rg_!M$. This statement asserts existence of an isomorphism only.

proof.text: For each geometric homology stalk V of K or M, constructibility makes V finitely generated. The coefficient hypothesis makes its underlying type finite. Faithfulness embeds End(V) into the finite type of self-functions of that underlying type. Thus its additive group is finite and id(V) has finite additive order; choose that positive order as annihilator. This is the fully proved local lemma finite_torsion_homology_stalks in the source module.

Set P=X times_B Y, p=fst, q=snd, and h=toBase. Quasi-compactness of q follows from that of f by base change. Use the objectwise composition comparison on the external object (step 1), then the projection comparison for q with M as the constructible torsion target factor (step 2). Tensor the inverse of the base-change comparison for f,K on the right with M (step 3). Apply tensor symmetry inside Rg! to change the order to M tensor Lg*Rf!K.

Use the projection comparison for g with M as its constructible torsion source factor (step 4); it does not assert that Rf!K is constructible on this arbitrary base. Apply tensor symmetry on B. Compose these object isomorphisms. The source is definitionally Rh!(externalProduct f g K M), and the target is Rf!K tensor Rg!M.
